title: Gigantic Journeys consent record
description: One immutable, per-purpose opt-in/withdrawal record for the layered custom-avatar consent (AUTH #044; SECURITY_CHECKLIST §5.1; legal/BIPA_CONSENT.md §4). Proof of consent — it carries NO image and NO raw biometric. A `granted:false` record is a withdrawal. No action in a purpose is permitted without a matching `granted:true` record.

user_id.description: Pseudonymous auth uid — never a name, email, or device id.

purpose.description: The specific, unbundled purpose this record consents to (or withdraws).

policy_version.description: Consent-copy version; a new version re-prompts and writes a new record (§5.5).

consent_text_hash.description: sha256 of the exact on-screen consent statement, so we can prove what was shown.
